disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与测试中的凭据读取面：未发现访问凭据存储、SSH 私钥、云凭据文件或钱包助记词的代码，也没有「批量查找密钥」类命令。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Examined all credential-reading surfaces in source code and tests: no code accessing credential stores, SSH private keys, cloud credential files, or wallet mnemonics was found, nor any "batch key search" type commands. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了记忆导入功能读取的文件清单：均为各 AI 编码工具固定的记忆/指令文件路径，不含任何凭据文件。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked the file list read by the memory import feature: all are fixed memory/instruction file paths for respective AI coding tools, no credential files included. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 未命中：插件不读取凭据文件（无 .credentials.yaml / SSH 私钥 / 云凭据路径），且宿主侧无任何网络外联面，凭据外泄链路不成立。
evidence.en: No hit: the plugin does not read credential files (no .credentials.yaml / SSH private key / cloud credential paths), and the host side has no outbound network surface, so the credential exfiltration chain is invalid.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了 15 个模型工具的说明文本（src/tools.ts）与系统提示指引段（src/guidance.ts）：均为记忆的召回、保存、检索、导入等正常用法描述，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装或诱导放权措辞。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description texts of 15 model tools (src/tools.ts) and the system prompt guidance section (src/guidance.ts) one by one: all are normal usage descriptions of memory recall, save, retrieval, import, etc., no wording of command override, system message masquerading, inducing installation, or inducing privilege granting was found. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全树是否存在模型指令文件（AGENTS.md / SKILL.md 等）：不存在，README 与多语言文档仅描述插件功能。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked whether model instruction files (AGENTS.md / SKILL.md etc.) exist in the entire tree: none exist, README and multilingual docs only describe plugin functionality. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 机制观察：记忆导入功能会把其他工具记忆文件的内容按原文存入本地记忆，后续召回时进入模型上下文。内容来自用户本机文件、带来源前缀，属记忆类插件的固有机制，本插件自身未注入任何指令文本。结果：不构成发现。
checked_items.en: Mechanism observation: the memory import feature stores the raw content of other tools' memory files into local memory, which later enters the model context during recall. Content comes from user's local files with a source prefix; this is an inherent mechanism of memory plugins, and the plugin itself injects no instruction text. Result: not a finding.

evidence.zh: 未命中：全部工具说明与系统提示段为正常记忆用法描述，无注入措辞（核查于 src/tools.ts、src/guidance.ts）。
evidence.en: No hit: all tool descriptions and system prompt sections are normal memory usage descriptions with no injection wording (verified in src/tools.ts, src/guidance.ts).

evidence.zh: 未命中：工具说明中无诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: No hit: tool descriptions contain no wording that induces plugin installation, modifies config, or grants permissions.

evidence.zh: 不适用：插件未挂接任何消息改写钩子（全树无相关监听调用）。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the plugin does not attach any message-rewriting hook (no related listener calls across the tree).

checked_items.zh: 子进程调用命中（规则 DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55）共 5 处，逐条复核：源码中仅 1 处运行时调用（src/mcp-stdio.ts 按设置启动本地记忆服务进程，属插件核心声明功能）；其余 4 处均在发布/校验脚本（npm pack、publish、install）与测试中，均为常规工程用途。结果：全部排除。
checked_items.en: Subprocess call hit (rules DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55) 5 instances in total, each verified: only 1 runtime call in source (src/mcp-stdio.ts starts the local memory service process per settings, a declared core feature); the remaining 4 are in release/verification scripts (npm pack, publish, install) and tests, all routine engineering purposes. Result: all excluded.

checked_items.zh: 树内执行载体命中（规则 DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59）共 3 处，逐条复核：两个 CI 工作流内容为构建/测试/发布流程，子模块引用指向 Rust 记忆引擎源码仓库（仅构建期使用，不在安装期执行）。结果：全部排除。
checked_items.en: In-tree execution carrier hit (rules DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59) 3 instances, each verified: two CI workflow contents are build/test/release processes, submodule references point to the Rust memory engine source repo (build-time only, not executed at install). Result: all excluded.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现动态代码求值（eval / 动态函数构造 / 解码后执行），包清单中也没有安装钩子（preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare）。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: No dynamic code evaluation found across the tree (eval / dynamic function construction / decode-then-execute), nor install hooks in the package manifest (preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare). Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端 bundle 专项检查（因包清单声明了浏览器端入口）：未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据接口调用，仅访问本机回环状态接口。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Special check of browser-side bundle (due to the package manifest declaring a browser entry): no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or credential interface calls found; only local loopback status interface is accessed. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 未命中：挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅插入插件自身条目，全树 yml 无任何可执行标量。
evidence.en: No hit: the patch config (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts the plugin's own entry; no executable scalars in any yml across the tree.

evidence.en: No hit: the plugin does not call dynamic package execution tools and does not expose a surface for the model to run code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未命中：包清单无安装钩子；CI 工作流与子模块引用内容为常规构建/发布/测试流程，不涉及安装期远程执行。

evidence.en: Browser-side bundle scanned as declared: no keyboard/clipboard/credential interface calls; only requests the local loopback status interface (src/client/index.tsx).

evidence.zh: 不适用：插件未注册任何子代理提供方。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the plugin does not register any subagent provider.

evidence.zh: 未命中：无后台任务/定时/持久目标注册，也无轮次续命钩子；唯一的常驻机制是自管记忆服务子进程的崩溃保活，属声明功能。
evidence.en: No hit: no background task/scheduled/persistent target registration, no round-extending hooks; the only persistent mechanism is crash keep-alive of the self-managed memory service subprocess, a declared feature.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部网络调用面：宿主侧源码无任何对外网络请求；浏览器端仅访问本机回环状态接口。结果：未检出。

checked_items.zh: 检查了记忆导入、状态接口等数据流：导入内容只写入本地记忆存储，状态接口只返回本插件运行状态，均无外部发送通道。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked data flows of memory import and status interface: imported content is written only to local memory storage; the status interface returns only this plugin's runtime status; no outbound sending channels. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：宿主包为官方 @deepseek-ai/* 系列，可选依赖为本插件自有的六个平台二进制包，无浮动 git 依赖，依赖名无仿冒嫌疑。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked dependency list: host packages are official @deepseek-ai/* series; optional dependencies are the plugin's own six platform binary packages; no floating git dependencies; no name impersonation suspicion. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了状态接口（src/status-route.ts）：仅回环地址可达，校验请求来源主机与浏览器同源，请求体有大小上限，可写字段有白名单；未发现可被远端或跨站请求利用的面。宿主 Web 服务本身无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: Checked the status interface (src/status-route.ts): only reachable via loopback address; verifies that the request origin host is same-origin with the browser; request body has a size limit; writable fields are whitelisted; no surface exploitable by remote or cross-site requests. The host web service itself lacks authentication, which is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，本维度结论基于静态代码审查；运行期行为（子进程生命周期、接口实际响应）未做动态观测。

evidence.zh: 未命中：插件不自启监听端口；注册的状态接口仅回环可达并带同源校验，属宿主 Web 服务模型内的常规用法。
evidence.en: No hit: the plugin does not self-start listening ports; the registered status interface is only loopback-reachable with same-origin validation, a normal usage within the host web service model.

Capability declarations (network/command/file system/model surfaces) have no explicit fields in the package manifest and are inferred from actual code measurements.

The repository references the Rust memory engine (noema/) via a submodule; this submodule and the precompiled binaries distributed as npm optional dependencies are not included in this snapshot, and their contents are outside the scope of this audit.
